findings.message: Typical AI-writing phrase; rewrite with a concrete detail.
Aspirin placed on gums or teeth burns the tissue; swallow it as directed.

findings.quote: Placing an aspirin directly against the gum helps numb the pain faster.
findings.why: Placing aspirin on the gum is not a recognized remedy, and mainstream dental guidance warns against it because it can burn the soft tissue.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence and replace it with a line saying that over-the-counter pain relievers should be taken by label directions and that aspirin should not be placed on the gums.

findings.quote: The ADA's [MouthHealthy page on dental emergencies]
findings.why: I cannot confirm that this URL resolves or that the page supports the sentence, so the citation is unverified.
findings.fix: Open the link, confirm it loads and covers the listed cases, and keep it only if it does; otherwise remove the citation.

findings.quote: a piece of sugar-free gum or dental wax can protect your tongue until you are seen
findings.why: The post offers gum as an equal option for covering a sharp edge without any source, and gum can stick to the area or come apart in the mouth.
findings.fix: Recommend only dental wax, or say to see a dentist promptly and avoid chewing on the broken area.

findings.why: This generic opener is a common AI-written filler phrase that adds nothing specific to the topic.
findings.fix: Start the post with the practical point, such as 'Knowing the first steps can protect a tooth while you get to a dentist.'
